title: C: reboot-safe airtime accounting lifecycle
description:
Connect accounting in lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_duty.c to suitable existing storage in hal_storage_redundant.c and startup in lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c. Restore valid active restrictions or conservatively wait out the applicable window. Reboot, reset, radio reinitialization and wall-clock correction must not erase a physical resource's restriction. Persistence failure must remain visible to admission.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use the minimum existing persistence integration or conservative wait-out needed for correctness, not a new storage framework. Keep airtime state separate from replay, identity, schedule generation and key portability. Do not modify audited OSCORE/EDHOC persistence or security semantics. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addresses, radio-owned keys, baseline SCHC/security and existing best-effort custody policy.
acceptance_criteria: Use vectors.09 independent restart/interval traces through production initialization and ledger APIs. Test valid restore, torn/missing/corrupt state, storage errors, unknown downtime, clock correction and exact release boundaries. Assert no new transmit eligibility solely from reboot or reinit. Extend lichen/tests/hal_storage_redundant, lichen/tests/nvs_persistence and regional-duty/native integration tests. Run local Linux/heft host/native sanitizers and lint using the verified west pin, currently v4.1.0; no device ports or RF activity.
